:::{#exr-bernoulli-score-contribution-deviation}
#### Score contribution in terms of deviation and precision

In the setting of @exr-bernoulli-score-contribution, let:

- $\devn_\iobs \eqdef \outvar_\iobs - \prob$ be the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean) of $\outvar_\iobs$ from the mean $\prob$ of $\Outvar_\iobs$;
- $\precision \eqdef 1 / \Var{\Outvar_\iobs}$ be the [precision](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-precision) of $\Outvar_\iobs$.

Write the [score](#def-score) contribution using $\devn_\iobs$ and $\precision$.

:::
